independent_scope: POSIX held-directory and file descriptors, ownership/mode/type/link-count, bounded read and named/descriptor final fences
AES-256-GCM metadata/key/nonce/hash/tag/JSON/UTF-16 validation against exact Node producer

resolved_findings.finding: Original draft canonicalized arbitrary supplied grandparent before checking trusted roots, admitting an arbitrary lexical alias to a temporary root.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final source first requires exact generated temporary-root location/platform alias shape, then canonicalizes; actual symlink alias negative demonstrates same reachable bytes are refused, genuine generated path remains accepted.

resolved_findings.finding: The after-open deadline control admitted its real filesystem work with only100ms.
resolved_findings.resolution: The fixture now allows a bounded5s setup window, then consumes that same Instant before the actual read; no product or original workload deadline changes.

findings: Root is resolved only within the allowed generated temporary-root layout, opened read-only/no-follow as held descriptor; private child and payload open relative to held descriptors with no-follow. No path reopen is used to read contents.

Private child and regular file must belong to current real UID, have no group/other mode access, and payload must have one link. Payload open is nonblocking before regular-file refusal, so FIFO test does not block waiting for a writer.

Bounded read caps actual bytes and checks the original Instant each iteration. Before/after file identity includes device,inode,UID,mode,link count,size,mtime,ctime; named entries are compared to held child/file descriptors after reading.
Return/error paths use owned File RAII. There is no permission repair, payload write, process launch, retry, or raw error/path export.

Fixed canonical unpadded base64url rejects length/alphabet/nonzero-padding aliases. Ciphertext SHA256 is checked before GCM authentication; generated Node cipher appends its16-byte authentication tag and uses empty AAD, matching ring open_in_place.

Authenticated plaintext must be UTF-8 JSON object with no recursive payload reference, correct PostToolUse event and exact tool_name/config_path/is_error copies, plus JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit count. Outer source identity/request digest remains the separate edge/receipt peer scope.
Deadline is an original absolute Instant throughout; metadata/read/crypto results do not restart it. Final hydrate and existing edge checks retain late-result refusal.
limits: This is source review of unformatted/uncompiled Rust; hosted pinned compilation and declared positive/negative controls remain required.
Synchronous filesystem syscalls cannot be forcibly interrupted by these checks; no hard per-syscall cancellation or complete adversarial scheduling proof is claimed.
POSIX privacy here is UID/mode plus held descriptor/path identity. This does not establish additional platform ACL or remote-filesystem semantics beyond those checks.
Windows intentionally retains unsupported behavior; no Windows handle/ACL admission is claimed.
No new source reader can turn prior failed original Pi/OMP delivery into retrospective success. Actual installed original contract validation remains separate.
